Today's international headlines:
- Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed: The prime minister of Australia, which co-hosted COP31, attributed the failure to "difficult geopolitical times".
- What's next after no deal at COP31 climate talks?: The talks have been the longest-running in the summit's history, with negotiations breaking down two days after they had been due to end.
- Boy, 7, pulled alive from rubble hours after Russian strike on Ukraine, rescuers say: Eleven people are dead in the attack on Dymer, with rescue efforts ongoing to find those still missing from the residential building.
- San Francisco is enjoying an AI boom, but worries about a crash are growing: AI employees in the industry's epicentre - San Francisco - worry that the sector is overheated.
- Burnham to tell MPs 'landmark' EU deal could make next decade 'much better': The prime minister will tell MPs the deal agreed on Friday is a "choice between a broken status quo or change".
- Three killed and dozens missing after fire at Indonesian factory: At least three people were killed and many more feared dead after a fire at a confectionary factory.
- Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony: The couple have been together for four years and were engaged in 2025.
- South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.
- Explosion on Russian ship at Libya port caused by suspected drone attack, officials say: Libya's eastern government says the ship had stopped for fuel and supplies on its way back to Russia.
- Democrats win largest House majority since 1992 after flipping North Carolina seat: Democrats have now won at least 258 seats in the midterms compared to Republicans, who hold at least 173 seats.
- US Army to detonate tonnes of unstable explosives in Iowa despite court order: The Army says "swift action" is necessary to protect its personnel and nearby communities around its ammunition plant in Iowa.
- 'Danger seems greater all the time': Ukrainians search for missing after Russian strikes: The BBC's Sarah Rainsford reports from the scene of a collapsed residential building in Ukraine's Kyiv region.
